claim: Layang-Layang sits on the lower plate: rifted continental crust detached from the South China conjugate margin and transported south by South China Sea opening.
source: Arif ENTERPRISE relay 2026-09-30; Steuer et al. 2012/2014; Taylor 2025 conjugate-margin reappraisal

claim: BU is a diachronous process surface, not a fixed chronohorizon; on paleo-highs carbonate growth may begin before the time-equivalent BU.
source: 2024 DG framework (enterprise relay) + Chang et al. 2023

claim: At COLLISION_MM the province recorded RU: carbonate drowning and pelagic drape without major erosion; the block subsided. RU is not necessarily the same reflector as the inboard DRU/MMU.
No well penetrates the complete syn-rift package; deep syn-rift lithology remains highly uncertain — the best-constrained part of the DG framework is relative tectonic order, not absolute ages.
Atoll/platform fate is contested: drowned-subsiding platform models vs Hutchison (2010) 'no evidence of drowned carbonate reefs' in the province. Contradiction preserved, unarbitrated.
